description: This file contains unit tests for the network manager plugin, specifically focusing on WiFi-related functionalities such as scanning, connecting, disconnecting, and querying WiFi state. It uses Google Test framework and mocks various external dependencies.

classes.name: NetworkManagerWifiTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing WiFi functionalities of the network manager plugin. Sets up mocks, initializes the plugin, and handles cleanup after tests.

methods.name: RegisteredMethods
methods.description: Checks if the expected methods are registered in the JSON RPC handler.

methods.name: get_wifi_device_devices_null
methods.description: Tests the behavior when no WiFi devices are returned by the nm_client_get_devices call.

methods.name: WiFiAlreadyDisconnected
methods.description: Tests disconnecting WiFi when the device is already in the disconnected state.

methods.name: WiFiAlreadyConnected_failed
methods.description: Tests disconnect behavior when the device is already connected and in an active state, expecting failure.

methods.name: WiFiAlreadyConnected_failed_errorCode
methods.description: Tests disconnect failure handling when disconnect finish reports different error codes.

methods.name: WiFiAlreadyConnected_success
methods.description: Tests disconnect behavior when the device is unexpectedly still connected, expecting success.

methods.name: GetConnectedSSID_deviceError
methods.description: Tests fetching the connected SSID when device state is unmanaged, expecting failure.

methods.name: GetConnectedSSID_ApNotConnected
methods.description: Tests fetching SSID when the device is connected but no access point is active.

methods.name: GetConnectedSSID_ApNotNull
methods.description: Tests fetching SSID details when an active access point is present with detailed security info.

methods.name: GetConnectedSSID_Connected_psk
methods.description: Tests fetching SSID details with PSK security, validating security flags and signal info.

methods.name: GetConnectedSSID_Connected_EAP
methods.description: Tests fetching SSID details with EAP security method.

methods.name: GetConnectedSSID_Connected_ssidNull
methods.description: Tests fetching SSID when SSID string is empty.

methods.name: GetWifiState_Disconnect
methods.description: Fetches WiFi state when devices are disconnected. Expects disconnected state.

methods.name: GetWifiState_Connected
methods.description: Fetches WiFi state when devices are connected. Expects connected state.

methods.name: GetWifiState_Pairing
methods.description: Fetches WiFi state during pairing stages. Expects pairing state.

methods.name: GetWifiState_unknown
methods.description: Fetches WiFi state with unknown device state. Expects unknown/disabled.

methods.name: GetWifiState_Connecting
methods.description: Fetches WiFi state when connecting. Expects connecting state.

methods.name: GetWifiState_Disabled
methods.description: Fetches WiFi state when device is unmanaged. Expects disabled state.

methods.name: StartWiFiScan_Failed
methods.description: Tests scenario where WiFi scan request fails.

methods.name: StartWiFiScan_with_SSIDList
methods.description: Tests WiFi scan request with a list of SSIDs.

methods.name: StartWiFiScan_with_Frequency
methods.description: Tests WiFi scan request specifying a frequency.

methods.name: StartWiFiScan_with_failed_with_error
methods.description: Simulates failure during WiFi scan request.

methods.name: StartWiFiScan_with_option_success
methods.description: Tests WiFi scan with additional options.

methods.name: WiFiConnect_long_ssid
methods.description: Tests connection attempt with an excessively long SSID string.

methods.name: WiFiConnect_activateKnownConnection_failed_device_null
methods.description: Tests WiFi connection attempt when device retrieval returns null.

methods.name: WiFiConnect_activateKnownConnection_failed_noconnection
methods.description: Tests connection activation failure when no connection is available.

methods.name: WiFiConnect_activateKnownConnection_failed_noconnection_id
methods.description: Tests connection activation failure with no valid connection ID.

methods.name: WiFiConnect_activateKnownConnection_failed_type_null
methods.description: Tests connection failure when the connection type is null.

methods.name: WiFiConnect_activateKnownConnection_failed
methods.description: Tests generic failure during connection activation.

methods.name: WiFiConnect_activateKnownConnection_success
methods.description: Tests successful activation of a known WiFi connection.

methods.name: WiFiConnect_with_same_ssid
methods.description: Tests connection attempt when the SSID matches the last scanned one.

methods.name: WiFiConnect_with_Ap_list_null
methods.description: Tests connection attempt when access point list is null.

methods.name: WiFiConnect_with_different_ssid
methods.description: Tests connection attempt with a different SSID, expecting failure.

methods.name: AddToKnownSSIDs_deviceFailed
methods.description: Tests adding an SSID to known list when device retrieval fails.

methods.name: AddToKnownSSIDs_SmallPssword
methods.description: Tests adding a new SSID with a short passphrase.

methods.name: AddToKnownSSIDs_sae_failed
methods.description: Tests adding an SSID with SAE security where the operation fails.

methods.name: AddToKnownSSIDs_sae_update_success
methods.description: Tests successful update of an existing SSID with SAE security.

methods.name: AddToKnownSSIDs_sae_update_failed
methods.description: Tests failure when updating an SSID with SAE security.

methods.name: AddToKnownSSIDs_sae_success
methods.description: Tests successful addition of an SSID with SAE security.

methods.name: GetKnownSSIDs_connectionFailed
methods.description: Tests retrieval of known SSIDs when connection list retrieval fails.

methods.name: GetKnownSSIDs_success
methods.description: Tests successful retrieval of known SSIDs from the plugin.

methods.name: RemoveKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Tests removing all known SSIDs, expecting failure if no connections.

methods.name: RemoveKnownSSIDs_success_false
methods.description: Tests removal of a known SSID when deletion fails.

methods.name: RemoveKnownSSIDs_success_true
methods.description: Tests successful removal of a known SSID.

methods.name: RemoveKnownSSIDs_conn_id_null
methods.description: Tests removal when connection ID is null.

methods.name: RemoveKnownSSIDs_success_ssid_specified_not_found
methods.description: Tests removal of specified SSID that is not found in the current connections.

methods.name: RemoveKnownSSIDs_success_ssid_specified_found
methods.description: Tests successful removal of a specified SSID found in current connections.

methods.name: StopWPS
methods.description: Tests stopping a WPS session; expects success.

methods.name: StartWPS
methods.description: Tests starting a WPS session; expects success.
